character.name: Wisp
traits: Graveyard Whisperer: Can speak with a corpse once per long rest to ask up to 3 questions, though answers are often cryptic or deliberately false
Light-Footed: Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made in dim light or darkness
Jittery Surface: Appears cheerful and carefree in social interactions, but has disadvantage on saving throws against fear effects and is easily startled
Sneak Attack (1d6): Deal an extra 1d6 damage to a creature once per turn if you have advantage on the attack roll, or if an ally is within 5 feet of the target
character.gear: Scuffed leather armor · Rusted iron dagger · Bone-tipped thieves' tools · 3 strips of grave-smoked dried meat · Hedge witch's healing potion · Tattered graveyard map · Tarnished silver locket · 50-foot hempen rope
character.story: Raised among the crooked headstones of the Whispering Fen Graveyard, Wisp learned to pick locks and listen to the dead after her mother was murdered for a stolen relic. Now she haunts the city's shadowed alleys, stealing back every trinket her mother ever owned. But the whispers have turned cruel lately — the dead lie, and Wisp can no longer tell if the voice guiding her is her mother's, or something wearing her skin.

inventory.name: Rusted iron dagger
inventory.lore: Carved from a coffin nail Wisp pried from a pauper's grave, its bone handle is stained with the dirt of a hundred midnight excavations.
inventory.description: A short, rusted iron dagger with a carved bone handle

inventory.name: Scuffed leather armor
inventory.lore: Stolen from the corpse of a grave robber who died in a cave-in, mended with graveyard moss and thread torn from burial shrouds.
inventory.description: Fitted brown leather armor, patched with moss in several places

inventory.name: Bone-tipped thieves' tools
inventory.lore: Wisp modified a set of stolen locksmith tools with tiny carved bone picks, letting her pick even the tightest grave locks without making a sound.
inventory.description: Set of lockpicks and tension wrenches fitted with carved bone accents
inventory.effects: Advantage on Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) and Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to pick locks or disarm traps

inventory.name: Grave-smoked dried meat
inventory.lore: Salted deer meat Wisp cures over low fires fed with graveyard driftwood, giving it a faint, earthy flavor and long shelf life.
inventory.description: Three strips of dry, salty cured meat

inventory.name: Hedge witch's healing potion
inventory.lore: Found tucked in the ribcage of a deceased hedge witch buried in the graveyard's oldest plot, its ruby glow never fades.
inventory.description: Small glass vial filled with glowing ruby-red liquid

inventory.name: Whispering Fen Graveyard map
inventory.lore: Hand-drawn by a previous graveyard dweller, marked with the locations of unmarked pauper graves and the plot where Wisp's mother was buried.
inventory.description: Water-stained parchment map, smudged with grave dirt

inventory.name: Tarnished silver locket
inventory.lore: The only relic Wisp has left of her mother, stolen by the city guard when they buried her. It glows faintly when near a corpse, amplifying the dead's whispers.
inventory.description: Small dented silver locket on a frayed leather cord, empty inside
inventory.effects: When activated, grants advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks to discern truth from lies when questioning a corpse, once per long rest

inventory.name: 50-foot hempen rope
inventory.lore: Stolen from a traveling merchant, used by Wisp to climb over graveyard walls and lower herself into deep, unmarked graves.
inventory.description: Coarse hempen rope, frayed at one end

inventory.name: Tattered graveyard map
inventory.lore: En liten sak från en svunnen tid — värdelös för de flesta, ovärderlig för dig.
